reason: The gaze alternates predominantly along the horizontal axis between left (around -4 to -7 deg) and right (around +5 to +8 deg) positions with relatively stable vertical values within local segments, and each position is held for ~200–280 ms between large horizontal saccades spanning roughly 10–15 degrees or more. This pattern of repeated, large, mostly horizontal back-and-forth saccades with brief fixations is most consistent with the structured Horizontal Saccades task rather than the more irregular, multi-directional patterns expected in Random Saccades, Reading, Video Viewing, or the Balura Game, and it clearly is not a central Fixation task.
